shared_elements: horizontal bands of repeated geometric pattern
paired or flanking forms around a central area
justification: The most specific overlap is that both include schematic profile beings together with circular/oval signs and horizontal patterned bands. The biggest difference is that B is dominated by paired human figures holding large disc-like objects around a central emblematic figure, while A is mainly a carved field of separate animal figures and abstract signs arranged in registers, with no comparable human-disc ceremonial scene.
